method: Fixed structured arguments and expected outcomes written before running actual MCP stdio. No model translation, real customers, client install timing, or competitor runtime.

scenarios.prompt: The same supplier sent INV-001 twice with different dates and totals. Preserve both values and show why review is needed.
criteria: Two distinct candidate records in exact and normalized groups
Original dates and amounts preserved as explicit conflicting fields
scenarios.score_definition: 3 only when every frozen expected-output and workflow assertion passes; 0 on any failure. An operator acceptance score, not subjective quality or customer preference.

report.scope: Candidate review of supplied records only. No payment approval, fraud verdict, duplicate confirmation, ERP access, or completeness guarantee.

groups.explanation: Identical invoice references in the same exact scope. Amount/date conflicts remain visible and do not suppress this candidate.
References collide after ASCII case and space/hyphen/slash/dot normalization only. This may be a legitimate reference distinction.

policy.normalization: ASCII a-z to A-Z; remove only ASCII space, hyphen, slash and dot. Preserve leading zeros, all other characters and all Unicode.
limitations: Exact supplied identifiers only; no fuzzy supplier/entity joins or currency conversion.
Overlapping groups are independent reasons, not confirmed duplicate clusters. Candidate records are counted once; no recoverable amount is calculated.
Unflagged records are not safe-to-pay decisions. Missing history, altered dates/amounts and other reference variations can be missed.
Credit notes use positive absolute minor-unit totals and are compared only with credit notes.
Display labels never affect matching. ISO-like currency codes are syntax checked, not checked against a currency registry.

retrieval.preview_policy: Last two checks in this process for 30 minutes; resubmit after eviction, expiry or restart.

price.grants: lifetime Pro on the duplicate-invoice-check server

payment.agent_settleable_reason: This server has no agent-settleable payment rail. Payment is a card checkout a person completes in a browser. As of MCP 2026-07-28 the specification defines no payment primitive (SEP-2007 was closed unmerged on 2026-06-24), and no mainstream MCP client settles an x402 challenge without a separately installed, separately funded wallet bridge.

x402.note: No x402 challenge is issued and no PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header is accepted. Do not retry with a payment payload.

elicitation.message: "More than 3 saved reports" needs Pro on the duplicate-invoice-check server. Pro is a one-time $19.00, lifetime.

payment.human_step: Open the checkout URL in a browser and pay by card. Nothing else is required of the user.
payment.after_payment: Checkout shows a key of the form MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>. Pass it to the license_activate tool; it is verified offline against a built-in public key and nothing is sent anywhere.
